concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-add-payment-methods]] — 2024-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Customer Area guide for merchant-account method requests in TEST/LIVE, role and webhook prerequisites, asynchronous store creation, conditional 24-hour retry, activation/country settings and 90-day inactive deletion; configuration is not eligibility or payment-outcome proof.
warnings: Requirements table says subscribe to Payment method webhook; later section recommends Management webhooks. Preserve both source wordings without collapsing them into a confirmed notification state.
Request applies to merchant account, while paymentMethod.created describes later addition to a store and example includes storeId.
